title: SOUTHERN COPPER CORP/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Southern Copper Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the unexpected passing of President and CEO Oscar Gonzalez Rocha on April 13, 2026. The Board appointed Leonardo Contreras Lerdo de Tejada as interim CEO effective April 16, 2026, while the Board proceeds with its internal succession planning to identify a permanent successor. No compensation changes were approved for the interim CEO.
key_points: Oscar Gonzalez Rocha, President and CEO, passed away unexpectedly on April 13, 2026
Leonardo Contreras Lerdo de Tejada appointed interim CEO effective April 16, 2026
Interim CEO will continue serving on the Board of Directors
No changes to compensation approved for interim CEO at this time
Board is actively seeking a permanent CEO through succession planning
